subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

The squirrels bury the peanuts __beneath the snowy.__
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the term "**snowy**" which is an adjective and incorrect in this context.
 
• The correct term should be "**under the snow**."
 
• Using "**under the snow**" ensures** grammatical correctness and clarity.**

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The squirrels bury the peanuts **under the snow**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: No improvement** – This option is incorrect because the original sentence is not grammatically correct.
 
• **Option 3: under the snowiest** – This option is incorrect because "snowiest" is a superlative adjective and does not fit the context.
 
• **Option 4: under the snowier** – This option is incorrect because "snowier" is a comparative adjective and does not fit the context.
